events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: From Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us some of the most iconic comedy moments in British history. Raising a glass to John Cleese on his 87th birthday.

events.title: The Beatles' "White Album" anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking double album, officially titled "The Beatles" but commonly known as the "White Album," was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 58 years since The Beatles dropped their iconic 'White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that redefined what an album could be. Which track is on your repeat list?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the 35th anniversary of the death of the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today, 35 years since we lost a true icon. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. #FreddieMercury

events.title: The Beatles' "Rubber Soul" anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album "Rubber Soul" on December 3, 1965, marking a significant shift in their musical direction.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history: 61 years ago, The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. It's incredible how they kept evolving, isn't it?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the 46th anniversary of the tragic death of music icon and peace activist John Lennon, who was shot in 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate around the world. Imagine.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The iconic and influential musician David Bowie, born in 1947, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: David Bowie Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman today. David Bowie would have been 80. His artistic vision and incredible music continue to inspire generations.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, born in 1935, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Happy Birthday to The King. Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. Still shaking up the world with his timeless tracks.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist and Led Zeppelin founder Jimmy Page, born in 1944, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Jimmy Page Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the maestro, Jimmy Page. The architect of some of rock's greatest riffs. What's your favourite Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British singer Sir Rod Stewart, born in 1945, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rod Stewart Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 82nd Birthday to the one and only Sir Rod Stewart. Still got that unmistakable voice and swagger. What's your go-to Rod track?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of Madness, born in 1961, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Suggs Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to Suggs from Madness! Forever bringing that 'Our House' party vibe. What's your favourite Madness tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Paul Young, born in 1956, known for hits like "Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)," celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Paul Young Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young. Still sounds incredible, doesn't he? What's your favourite from his back catalogue?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music icon and businesswoman Dolly Parton, born in 1946, celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Dolly Parton Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true legend, songwriter, and force of nature. What's your favourite Dolly hit?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and successful singer-songwriter Gary Barlow, born in 1971, celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Gary Barlow Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From boyband heartthrob to musical theatre king, he's done it all. What's your favourite Take That track?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: British soul singer Billy Ocean, born in 1950, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Billy Ocean Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the incredible Billy Ocean! Get out your dancing shoes, because 'When the Going Gets Tough', he's always there.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first ceremony anniversary
events.blurb: The inaugural induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame took place in 1989, honouring rock's founding legends.

angles.name: Rock Hall Inaugural
angles.copy: It's 38 years since the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. A huge moment for music history, celebrating the pioneers of rock and roll.

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, born in 1972, celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Mark Owen Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday to Mark Owen! One quarter of Take That, and still making great music. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment?

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London on January 30, 1969.

angles.name: Beatles Rooftop Concert
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert. What a way to go out, eh? Still gives us goosebumps.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter and drummer Phil Collins, born in 1951, celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Phil Collins Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 76th Birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! From Genesis to solo superstardom, his drum fills are still legendary.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Award-winning singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake, born in 1981, celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Justin Timberlake Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 46th Birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boyband heartthrob to solo superstar, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.
